& Suggestion title): 
Root Cause: The code incorrectly uses `Math.min(r[i], r[i])` instead of `Math.min(r[i], l[i])`.
suggestion:
Suggestion 1. Correct the Comparison Logic Replace the incorrect line 
```java
for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = Math.max(ans, Math.min(r[i], r[i]));
```
with the correct line 
```java
for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) ans = Math.max(ans, Math.min(r[i], l[i]));
```
to ensure that `ans` is calculated using both `l` and `r` arrays as intended.
